verdict.rationale: Replicate is a model-hosting and inference API, so enforcing JSON-schema or grammar-constrained outputs is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions structured outputs, JSON schema enforcement, or grammar-constrained decoding. The cited docs cover running models, fine-tuning, deploying with Cog, autoscaling, pricing and image models only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably
